description: Presidential Secretariat - Appointed Mr. B. L. A. J. Dharmakeerthi as the  Secretary to the Ministry of Agriculture and Plantation Industries with effect from 27.10.2023
categorisation: This gazette content specifically announces the appointment of a named individual (Mr. B. L. A. J.
